mentions.name: rusto64
mentions.description: A Nintendo 64 emulator written in Rust with WebAssembly (WASM) compatibility. Development is still in progress with no visual or sound output yet; the current focus is building tools to debug the emulator's execution, with a live web demo of the debugger available.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a Nintendo 64 emulator made in Rust (WASM compatible).

https://gitlab.com/rusto64/core

No visual or sound yet; still working on making tools to debug the execution.

Live demo of the debugger : https://n64.watier.ca/
